name: diff-lens

plugins.name: diff-lens
plugins.description: See what changed, right where Claude points. Ask Claude to "guide me through this PR" and click any file link in its reply: the file opens with its changes against your base branch highlighted, scrolled to the linked line. Commands: /diff-lens (changed files), /diff-lens <file>:<line>, /diff-lens base <ref>.

description: diff-lens: see a file's changes against a base branch from any file link in Claude Code Desktop.
